انحصرن (form VII)
# اِنْحَصَرْنَ (inḥaṣarna) /in.ħa.sˤar.na/: third-person feminine plural past active of اِنْحَصَرَ (inḥaṣara)
# اِنْحَصِرْنَ (inḥaṣirna) /in.ħa.sˤir.na/: second-person feminine plural imperative of اِنْحَصَرَ (inḥaṣara)
